comparison.objective: Engage and close a jacket zipper while holding the hem, versus tune and lock a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization, pin-to-box insertion, and slider traversal; generic counterholding overlaps but the compliant fastening skill differs.
comparison.success_condition: Pin engaged and slider reaches collar, followed by release/reset; engagement depth, closure continuity, and damage limits are missing.
comparison.reason: Tests deformable-garment fastening rather than retained rotary calibration under repeated impacts.
